sources.section: Document Management - Institutional Repository and Digital Library Software
sources.entry: InvenioRDM - Highly scalable turn-key research data management platform with a beautiful user experience. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) MIT Python

summary.one_liner: InvenioRDM application layer (invenio-app-rdm) from inveniosoftware, a research data management platform for institutional repositories.
summary.what_it_does: The README is nearly empty: it contains the title, SPDX copyright headers, the MIT license identifier, badge placeholders, and a one-line description saying InvenioRDM is a research data management tool with a link to further documentation. It does not describe features, setup steps, or architecture in detail. Per the awesome-selfhosted listing, InvenioRDM is a highly scalable turn-key research data management platform with a polished user interface, and the listing links to a demo, source code, and clients. Treat the feature list as coming from that listing rather than the README.
notable: Turn-key research data management platform, per the awesome-selfhosted listing
Part of the Invenio framework from CERN and Northwestern University (per copyright headers)
Listed with a public demo and separate clients (per listing)
caveats: README is nearly empty; setup and feature details must be found in external documentation
Installation requirements are not stated in the README
